question: In which of the following union territories was the highest literacy rate recorded in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Literacy rate:-**

 
 
• The literacy rate is the total percentage of the population of an area at a particular time aged seven years or above who can read and write with understanding. 
 
• According to Census 2011 Lakshadweep, with a literacy rate of 92.28%, is the Union Territory with the highest literacy rate in India.
 
• The female literacy rate of Lakshadweep is 88.25%.
 
• Kerala ranks the highest in terms of literacy rate with a 93.91% literacy rate.
